run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the mailing list CC'd
run_main_with_cc: run the main function to invoke upload.py with a custom --cc flag appended
parse_cc_flag: parse command line arguments to detect and modify the --cc flag with the GTest group
resolve_upload_py_path: resolve the path to upload.py relative to the current script directory
execv_upload_py: execute upload.py via os.execv with modified arguments including the GTest mailing list
